integrity: Analytical proof and independent deterministic checks; priority assessment is same-model only, with broad Gaussian quadratic-function literature residual risk. The asymptotic quadratic variance is implied by existing general machinery.
scientific_limitations: Stationary overdamped planar harmonic OU, symmetric SPD drift with distinct eigenvalues and SPD diffusion; deterministic drift torque only. Bath optimization gives a nonattained supremum; no noisy angular momentum, work extraction, finite-sample guarantees or nonnormal drift.
title: Sharp finite-window torque detection threshold in a planar harmonic Brownian gyrator
